title: Feelings and personality
focus: 尴尬, 委屈, 焦虑, 内疚, 嫉妒, 羡慕, 后悔, 遗憾, 失望, 感动, 无奈, 固执, 谦虚, 靠谱, 敏感, 内向, 脾气, 情绪, 压力, 崩溃
body:
# Feelings and personality

You already have 高兴, 难过 and 生气. Adults need finer words: the difference between guilt and regret, jealousy and envy, a stressful week and a total meltdown. You also need words to describe what people are like, at work and in the family.

| Chinese | Pinyin | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 尴尬 | gāngà | awkward / embarrassing (a social situation) |
| 委屈 | wěiqu | to feel wronged / hurt by unfair treatment |
| 焦虑 | jiāolǜ | anxious (ongoing worry) |
| 内疚 | nèijiù | to feel guilty (about something you did) |
| 嫉妒 | jídù | jealous (resentful) |
| 羡慕 | xiànmù | to envy (in a harmless, admiring way) |
| 后悔 | hòuhuǐ | to regret (something you did or didn't do) |
| 遗憾 | yíhàn | a pity / regrettable (out of your control) |
| 失望 | shīwàng | disappointed |
| 感动 | gǎndòng | moved / touched (emotionally) |
| 无奈 | wúnài | resigned / helpless (nothing you can do about it) |
| 固执 | gùzhí | stubborn |
| 谦虚 | qiānxū | modest / humble |
| 自私 | zìsī | selfish |
| 靠谱 | kàopǔ | reliable / dependable (colloquial, of a person) |
| 敏感 | mǐngǎn | sensitive / touchy (a person or a topic) |
| 外向 | wàixiàng | outgoing / extroverted |
| 内向 | nèixiàng | introverted / reserved |
| 耐心 | nàixīn | patience / patient |
| 脾气 | píqi | temper / disposition |
| 情绪 | qíngxù | emotions / mood (often agitated or negative) |
| 压力 | yālì | pressure / stress |
| 崩溃 | bēngkuì | to break down / fall apart (emotionally) |
| 性格 | xìnggé | personality / character |
| 热心 | rèxīn | warm-hearted / eager to help others |
| 虚伪 | xūwěi | hypocritical / fake (insincere) |
| 发泄 | fāxiè | to vent / take out (anger, stress) |
| 松了一口气 | sōngle yì kǒu qì | to breathe a sigh of relief |

## Which word?

- **嫉妒 vs 羡慕**: 嫉妒 is resentful (he wants what you have and dislikes you for it). 羡慕 is friendly envy. 真羡慕你 is a compliment; 我嫉妒你 is a confession.
- **后悔 vs 遗憾**: 后悔 is regret over your own choice (我后悔没去). 遗憾 is 'what a pity', for things outside your control (你没来，很遗憾).
- **内疚 vs 不好意思**: 内疚 is real guilt that stays with you. 不好意思 is a quick 'sorry / embarrassed'.
- **焦虑 vs 着急 vs 紧张**: 焦虑 is ongoing anxiety. 着急 is worry about something urgent right now. 紧张 is nerves before an exam or a talk.
- **情绪 vs 心情**: 心情好/不好 is everyday mood. 情绪 leans toward agitated feelings: 情绪激动, 有情绪 (upset, disgruntled).
- **固执 vs 坚持**: same behavior, opposite judgment. 固执 is stubborn; 坚持 is persevering.

## Examples

- 他叫错了我的名字，场面有点尴尬。 tā jiàocuò le wǒ de míngzi, chǎngmiàn yǒudiǎn gāngà: He got my name wrong, and it was a bit awkward
- 明明不是她的错，她觉得特别委屈。 míngmíng bú shì tā de cuò, tā juéde tèbié wěiqu: It clearly wasn't her fault, so she felt really wronged
- 最近工作压力大，我有点焦虑。 zuìjìn gōngzuò yālì dà, wǒ yǒudiǎn jiāolǜ: Work's been stressful lately and I'm a bit anxious
- 没去机场接他，我挺内疚的。 méi qù jīchǎng jiē tā, wǒ tǐng nèijiù de: I feel pretty guilty I didn't pick him up at the airport
- 他嫉妒同事升职比他快。 tā jídù tóngshì shēngzhí bǐ tā kuài: He's jealous his coworker got promoted faster than him
- 我很后悔当时没听你的。 wǒ hěn hòuhuǐ dāngshí méi tīng nǐ de: I really regret not listening to you back then
- 房租又涨了，我也很无奈。 fángzū yòu zhǎng le, wǒ yě hěn wúnài: The rent went up again, and there's nothing I can do
- 这个人做事很靠谱，你放心吧。 zhège rén zuòshì hěn kàopǔ, nǐ fàngxīn ba: This guy is reliable, don't worry
- 他今天情绪不太好，你别惹他。 tā jīntiān qíngxù bú tài hǎo, nǐ bié rě tā: He's in a bad mood today, don't provoke him
- 电脑死机了，文件全没了，我快崩溃了。 diànnǎo sǐjī le, wénjiàn quán méi le, wǒ kuài bēngkuì le: My computer crashed and all my files are gone, I'm about to lose it

cards.Example: 他叫错了我的名字，场面有点尴尬。 tā jiàocuò le wǒ de míngzi, chǎngmiàn yǒudiǎn gāngà: He got my name wrong, and it was a bit awkward
cards.Notes: 尴尬 describes the situation or the feeling in it; 不好意思 is the lighter, personal 'sorry / embarrassed'

cards.English: to feel wronged / hurt by unfair treatment
cards.Example: 明明不是她的错，她觉得特别委屈。 míngmíng bú shì tā de cuò, tā juéde tèbié wěiqu: It clearly wasn't her fault, so she felt really wronged
cards.Notes: 受委屈 = to be treated unfairly; 别委屈自己 = don't sell yourself short

cards.Example: 最近工作压力大，我有点焦虑。 zuìjìn gōngzuò yālì dà, wǒ yǒudiǎn jiāolǜ: Work's been stressful lately and I'm a bit anxious
cards.Notes: 焦虑 = lingering anxiety (also the clinical word); 着急 = worried and impatient about something urgent; 紧张 = nervous in the moment

cards.English: to feel guilty (about something you did)
cards.Example: 没去机场接他，我挺内疚的。 méi qù jīchǎng jiē tā, wǒ tǐng nèijiù de: I feel pretty guilty I didn't pick him up at the airport
cards.Notes: Moral guilt only; legally guilty is 有罪. 惭愧 = ashamed of falling short

cards.Example: 他嫉妒同事升职比他快。 tā jídù tóngshì shēngzhí bǐ tā kuài: He's jealous his coworker got promoted faster than him
cards.Notes: 嫉妒 is resentful; 羡慕 is harmless envy; 吃醋 is romantic jealousy

cards.English: to envy (in a harmless, admiring way)
cards.Example: 真羡慕你，每天都不用加班。 zhēn xiànmù nǐ, měitiān dōu búyòng jiābān: I really envy you, never having to work overtime
cards.Notes: Friendly and positive, unlike 嫉妒

cards.English: to regret (something you did or didn't do)
cards.Example: 我很后悔当时没听你的。 wǒ hěn hòuhuǐ dāngshí méi tīng nǐ de: I really regret not listening to you back then
cards.Notes: 后悔 = regret your own choice; 遗憾 = it's a pity, often out of your control

cards.English: a pity / regrettable (out of your control)
cards.Example: 你没能来，真是太遗憾了。 nǐ méi néng lái, zhēn shì tài yíhàn le: It's such a shame you couldn't make it
cards.Notes: Politer and more formal than 可惜; 很遗憾地通知您 = we regret to inform you

cards.Example: 这个结果让大家很失望。 zhège jiéguǒ ràng dàjiā hěn shīwàng: Everyone was disappointed by the result
cards.Notes: 对……很失望 = disappointed in someone; 绝望 = despair, much stronger

cards.Example: 他说的话让我特别感动。 tā shuō de huà ràng wǒ tèbié gǎndòng: What he said really touched me
cards.Notes: 感动 = touched; 激动 = excited or worked up

cards.English: resigned / helpless (nothing you can do about it)
cards.Example: 房租又涨了，我也很无奈。 fángzū yòu zhǎng le, wǒ yě hěn wúnài: The rent went up again, and there's nothing I can do
cards.Notes: Slightly literary; the spoken equivalent is 没办法

cards.Example: 我爸特别固执，谁的话都不听。 wǒ bà tèbié gùzhí, shéi de huà dōu bù tīng: My dad is really stubborn and won't listen to anyone
cards.Notes: Negative; 坚持 is positive persistence; spoken 倔 (juè) is also common

cards.Example: 她很谦虚，从来不炫耀。 tā hěn qiānxū, cónglái bú xuànyào: She's very modest and never shows off
cards.Notes: 别谦虚了 = don't be so modest; 低调 = low-key, not flashy

cards.Example: 只考虑自己，太自私了。 zhǐ kǎolǜ zìjǐ, tài zìsī le: Only thinking about yourself is really selfish
这个人做事很靠谱，你放心吧。 zhège rén zuòshì hěn kàopǔ, nǐ fàngxīn ba: This guy is reliable, don't worry
cards.Notes: Colloquial; 不靠谱 = flaky. The formal word is 可靠

cards.English: sensitive / touchy (a person or a topic)
cards.Example: 这个话题比较敏感，吃饭的时候别提。 zhège huàtí bǐjiào mǐngǎn, chīfàn de shíhou bié tí: This topic is touchy, don't bring it up over dinner
cards.Notes: Works for people and topics; 过敏 = allergic

cards.Example: 她性格外向，跟谁都聊得来。 tā xìnggé wàixiàng, gēn shéi dōu liáo de lái: She's outgoing and gets along with everyone
cards.Notes: Usually said of 性格: 性格外向

cards.Example: 我比较内向，不太喜欢参加聚会。 wǒ bǐjiào nèixiàng, bú tài xǐhuan cānjiā jùhuì: I'm fairly introverted and don't really like parties
教小孩一定要有耐心。 jiāo xiǎohái yídìng yào yǒu nàixīn: You have to be patient teaching kids
cards.Notes: 有耐心 / 没耐心; also an adjective: 他很耐心

cards.Example: 他脾气不好，动不动就发火。 tā píqi bù hǎo, dòngbudòng jiù fāhuǒ: He has a bad temper and blows up at the slightest thing
cards.Notes: 发脾气 = to lose your temper; 脾气好 = easygoing

cards.Example: 他今天情绪不太好，你别惹他。 tā jīntiān qíngxù bú tài hǎo, nǐ bié rě tā: He's in a bad mood today, don't provoke him
cards.Notes: 心情 = how you feel (good or bad); 情绪 = emotional state, and 有情绪 means upset or disgruntled

cards.Example: 压力太大了，我晚上都睡不着。 yālì tài dà le, wǒ wǎnshang dōu shuì bu zháo: I'm so stressed I can't sleep at night
cards.Notes: 压力大 = stressed; 减压 = de-stress

cards.Example: 电脑死机了，文件全没了，我快崩溃了。 diànnǎo sǐjī le, wénjiàn quán méi le, wǒ kuài bēngkuì le: My computer crashed and all my files are gone, I'm about to lose it
cards.Notes: Often used as casual exaggeration; also for systems and economies collapsing

cards.Example: 他们俩性格不合，老吵架。 tāmen liǎ xìnggé bù hé, lǎo chǎojià: Their personalities clash and they're always arguing
cards.Notes: 性格 = overall temperament; 个性 = individuality, what makes someone distinctive

cards.Example: 邻居阿姨特别热心，经常帮我们拿快递。 línjū āyí tèbié rèxīn, jīngcháng bāng wǒmen ná kuàidì: The lady next door is really kind and often picks up our packages
cards.Notes: 热心 = eager to help; 热情 = warm and enthusiastic in manner (a host, a welcome)

cards.Example: 他当面一套，背后一套，太虚伪了。 tā dāngmiàn yí tào, bèihòu yí tào, tài xūwěi le: He says one thing to your face and another behind your back, so fake
cards.Notes: Spoken alternative: 假 or 装

cards.Example: 你别把气发泄在我身上。 nǐ bié bǎ qì fāxiè zài wǒ shēnshang: Don't take it out on me
cards.Notes: Pattern: 把……发泄在……身上

cards.English: to breathe a sigh of relief
cards.Example: 听说他没事，我终于松了一口气。 tīngshuō tā méi shì, wǒ zhōngyú sōngle yì kǒu qì: Hearing he was okay, I finally breathed a sigh of relief

cards.Notes: Said to smooth things over after a harsh remark

cards.English: Calm down, don't get worked up.
cards.Notes: 激动 = agitated or excited; 冷静 = calm, composed
